about: Provenance and the human defect-check verdict for every image under public/vantage/img/. Devices are written by scripts/fetch-vantage-devices.mjs; promos, heroes, plans, modules and placeholders by scripts/generate-vantage-art.mjs. A verdict holds only for the sha256 it was given to; a changed file reads pending. No image carries a carrier mark; the makers' own marks on their devices are part of the product.
